mapper.sql: id, wallet_id, account_id, transaction_type, parent_transaction_id, amount, status, remark, failure_reason, created_at, completed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transaction (wallet_id, account_id, transaction_type, parent_transaction_id, amount, status, remark, failure_reason, next_retry_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{walletId}, #{accountId}, #{transactionType}, #{parentTransactionId}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{failureReason}, NOW(), #{completedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM transaction WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} AND transaction_type = 'CHARGE' AND status IN ('CREATED','WITHDRAWING','WITHDRAWN','DEPOSITING','UNKNOWN','COMPENSATING')

SELECT t.id, t.wallet_id, t.account_id, t.transaction_type, t.parent_transaction_id, t.amount, t.status, t.remark, t.failure_reason, t.created_at, t.completed_at FROM transaction t JOIN wallet w ON t.wallet_id = w.id WHERE t.id = #{id} AND w.user_id = #{userId} AND t.transaction_type = 'CHARGE'
mapper.update: UPDATE transaction SET lease_expires_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), lease_token = lease_token + 1, first_attempt_at = COALESCE(first_attempt_at, NOW()) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT lease_token FROM transaction WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT retry_count, max_retries, requery_count, first_attempt_at AS firstAttemptAt, external_idempotency_key AS externalIdempotencyKey FROM transaction WHERE id = #{id}
